disclaimer: General illustrative content, not a personalized prediction. The date ranges follow the popular tropical sun-sign calendar. A Vedic consultation uses the sidereal zodiac and the whole birth chart. These notes are sample writing for the layout.

signs.name: Aries
signs.description: Aries is the sign of beginnings. In general writing it is associated with initiative, candour, and a dislike of waiting. Treat this as a sketch of the sign, not a description of any person.
signs.daily: The illustrative note for today is about pace. Starting is the familiar strength. Leaving a little room before the next decision is the quieter one.
signs.weekly: This sample week asks for a look at where urgency is useful and where it is only noise. A point made once, clearly, travels further than a point made three times.
signs.monthly: The sample month favours finishing something already started. New plans can wait until the current one has a shape you can describe.

signs.name: Taurus
signs.description: Taurus is associated with steadiness, the senses, and a preference for what can be relied on. People are more than a sun-sign sentence.
signs.daily: A useful illustrative theme is patience with the body and the schedule. A simple routine counts more, today, than a dramatic change.
signs.weekly: The sample week favours maintenance: money, home, and the work already in hand. A slow yes is still a yes.
signs.monthly: Over a sample month, the theme is protecting what is already working. Review a commitment before adding another.

signs.name: Gemini
signs.description: Gemini is associated with curiosity, speech, and moving between ideas. A birth chart shows much more than this sketch.
signs.daily: Ask one real question and stay for the answer, rather than collecting five questions and answering none of them.
signs.weekly: Writing, messages, and short journeys are the sample themes. Not every thought needs to be sent on the day it arrives.
signs.monthly: The sample month rewards a single subject studied properly. Breadth can return after that subject has been given a fair hour.

signs.name: Cancer
signs.description: Cancer is associated with home, memory, and care. The sign is often described as protective, sometimes to the point of retreat.
signs.daily: An illustrative theme is a private conversation that does not need an audience. Offer care without taking the decision over.
signs.weekly: Family questions may ask for a boundary as well as warmth. The two can sit in the same sentence.
signs.monthly: The sample month is for settling a domestic matter in practical terms: time, space, or a decision that has been postponed.

signs.name: Leo
signs.description: Leo is associated with visibility, loyalty, and a wish to be met honestly. At its best, pride is simply care for one's word.
signs.daily: Let recognition be a side effect of doing the thing well. The sample note is about the work, not the applause.
signs.weekly: Creative work and questions of leadership sit in the foreground. If other people helped, name them specifically.
signs.monthly: A sample month to present something you have already practised, not something assembled the night before.

signs.name: Virgo
signs.description: Virgo is associated with discernment, craft, and the wish to be useful. Critique is a tool. It is not a sentence passed on a temperament.
signs.daily: Improve one small process and leave the rest of the list alone. Completeness is not the same as worth.
signs.weekly: The sample week is for careful work and an ordinary routine. Precision is plenty. Perfection is optional.
signs.monthly: Offer the skill you actually have. A sample month favours help that stays within honest limits.

signs.name: Libra
signs.description: Libra is associated with balance, partnership, and an eye for what is fair. Agreement is not the same thing as disappearance.
signs.daily: Say the preference you have been polishing into politeness. Fairness includes you.
signs.weekly: The sample theme is one relationship conversation, with a clear request and enough time to listen.
signs.monthly: Agreements and collaboration are the sample focus. A decision taken late is still better than a borrowed opinion.

signs.name: Scorpio
signs.description: Scorpio is associated with depth, privacy, and emotional courage. Intensity is not the same thing as doom, and a chart is not a threat.
signs.daily: The illustrative note is restraint. Not every insight has to be spoken on the day it arrives.
signs.weekly: Research and private reckoning are sample themes. Avoid an all-or-nothing conclusion while the facts are still arriving.
signs.monthly: A useful sample month for closing a matter that has lingered: a conversation, a debt of attention, or a habit.

signs.name: Sagittarius
signs.description: Sagittarius is associated with meaning, teachers, and wide horizons. Optimism still needs a map.
signs.daily: Learn one thing from a person who disagrees with you. The sample note is curiosity without the speech.
signs.weekly: Study, travel plans, and belief are the sample themes. Keep any new promise small enough to keep.
signs.monthly: Aim the month at a question you actually care about. Breadth without a question becomes restlessness.

signs.name: Capricorn
signs.description: Capricorn is associated with duty, structure, and long horizons. Ambition can be quiet and still be serious.
signs.daily: Do the next necessary thing. The sample note leaves reputation to catch up on its own.
signs.weekly: Work and responsibility are the sample themes. A boundary around the work is part of doing it.
signs.monthly: Build one durable system: a schedule, a saving, or a skill practised on ordinary days.

signs.name: Aquarius
signs.description: Aquarius is associated with independence, ideas, and the wider group. Distance is not the same thing as clarity.
signs.daily: Include someone in the thought you were going to solve alone. The illustrative theme is company, not compromise.
signs.weekly: Friends, community, and future plans are sample themes. An ideal lands better when it has a practical first step.
signs.monthly: A sample month for contributing to a shared effort without needing to redesign all of it first.

signs.name: Pisces
signs.description: Pisces is associated with imagination, compassion, and porous boundaries. Sensitivity is a gift that still needs a shore.
signs.daily: Rest is a sufficient theme. Art, prayer, or quiet is enough. You do not have to solve someone else's day.
signs.weekly: Finish a gentle creative task, and decline one demand that is not yours. Both belong in the sample week.
signs.monthly: Compassion with a limit. The sample month favours a spiritual practice that is ordinary and repeatable.
